q.en: When was Thomas Alva Edison born?
q.zh: 托马斯·阿尔瓦·爱迪生生于何时？

options.en: October 18, 1931. In 1876 Edison built a lab in Menlo Park, New Jersey, described as the first for-profit research lab, the 'invention factory.'
options.zh: 1931年10月18日。1876年，爱迪生在新泽西州门洛帕克建立了实验室，被描述为第一家营利性研究实验室，即“发明工厂”

explain.en: The book states Thomas Alva Edison was born on February 11, 1847.
explain.zh: 书中写明托马斯·阿尔瓦·爱迪生出生于1847年2月11日。

q.en: Why did young Edison leave school?
q.zh: 小时候的爱迪生为什么离开了学校？

options.en: He had finished all the grades
options.zh: 他已经读完了所有年级

options.en: School didn't let him explore and ask questions, so his mother taught him at home
options.zh: 学校不允许他探索和提问，于是母亲在家教他

options.en: His family moved to another country and settled in London, where young Thomas attended a famous boarding school and later sailed to Africa as a merchant.
options.zh: 他家搬到了另一个国家，定居在伦敦；年幼的托马斯上了一所著名的寄宿学校，后来作为商人远航去了非洲。

options.en: He had to work full time immediately

explain.en: The book says Al did not do well in school because students only memorized facts, so his mother removed him and taught him at home.
explain.zh: 书中说阿尔在学校表现不好，因为学生只背事实，于是母亲让他退学并在家教导他。

q.en: What was Thomas Edison's first patent for?
q.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生的第一项专利是关于什么的？

options.en: The light bulb, which he famously invented in 1879 after only a single afternoon of work and sold to every home in America within a year.
options.zh: 电灯泡——他于1879年声名远扬地发明，只花了一个下午就完成，并在一年内卖给了美国的每一户家庭。

explain.en: The book says Edison received his first patent, for an electric vote counter, in 1869, and that it did not do well.
explain.zh: 书中说爱迪生1869年获得了第一项专利——电子投票计数器，不过它卖得并不好。

q.en: Where did Edison build the first for-profit research lab, called the 'invention factory'?
q.zh: 爱迪生在哪里建立了第一家营利性研究实验室，即“发明工厂”？

options.en: West Orange, New Jersey, where he opened his very first laboratory in 1850 at the age of three and built the telephone there.
options.zh: 新泽西州西奥兰治，他于1850年、年仅三岁时就在那里开办了第一间实验室，并在那儿发明了电话。

explain.en: In 1876 Edison built a lab in Menlo Park, New Jersey, described as the first for-profit research lab, the 'invention factory.'
explain.zh: 1876年，爱迪生在新泽西州门洛帕克建立了实验室，被描述为第一家营利性研究实验室，即“发明工厂”。

q.en: What was the first thing Edison recorded on the phonograph?
q.zh: 爱迪生在留声机上录下的第一句话是什么？

options.en: A political speech he recorded for President Lincoln in 1860, which became the first sound ever captured on any machine.
options.zh: 他为林肯总统在1860年录下的一篇政治演讲，那也是任何机器捕捉到的第一段声音。

explain.en: The book says the first thing Edison recorded was the nursery rhyme 'Mary Had a Little Lamb.'
explain.zh: 书中说爱迪生录下的第一句话是儿歌《玛丽有只小羊羔》。

q.en: According to the book, what did Edison's workers try thousands of materials to find?
q.zh: 根据书中内容，爱迪生的团队试了上千种材料是为了找到什么？

options.en: The filament for the light bulb
The telephone wire, which took his team only one day to perfect and made him richer than the light bulb ever did.
options.zh: 电话线，他的团队只花一天就完善它，并让他比电灯泡更富有。

explain.en: The book says the first challenge was finding a material for the filament, and workers tried thousands of materials until one worked.
explain.zh: 书中说第一个难题是寻找灯丝材料，工人们试了上千种材料，直到找到一种可用的。

q.en: In the 'War of the Currents,' which method eventually became dominant?
q.zh: 在“电流之战”中，哪种供电方式最终占据了主导？

options.en: Edison's direct current (DC), which won the War of the Currents and still powers nearly every home in the world today.
options.zh: 爱迪生的直流电（DC），它赢得了电流之战，并且至今仍为世界上几乎每一户家庭供电。
西屋与特斯拉的交流电（AC）

explain.en: The book explains Edison used DC, while Westinghouse used AC (invented by Tesla), and AC eventually became dominant.
explain.zh: 书中解释爱迪生采用直流电，而西屋公司采用特斯拉发明的交流电，最终交流电占据了主导。

q.en: How many patents did Edison obtain in his lifetime?
q.zh: 爱迪生一生共获得了多少项专利？

options.en: 3,500. In 1876 Edison built a lab in Menlo Park, New Jersey, described as the first for-profit research lab, the 'invention factory.'
options.zh: 3,500项。1876年，爱迪生在新泽西州门洛帕克建立了实验室，被描述为第一家营利性研究实验室，即“发明工厂”

explain.en: The book says throughout his life Edison obtained 1,093 patents, a record at the time.
explain.zh: 书中说爱迪生一生共获得1,093项专利，在当时是一项纪录。

q.en: What does the book suggest about Edison's attitude toward failure?
q.zh: 书中体现了爱迪生对失败持怎样的态度？

options.en: He said negative results were as valuable as positive ones because they showed what did not work
options.zh: 他说负面结果和正面结果一样有价值，因为它们表明哪些方法行不通

options.en: He only succeeded on the first try for every invention, including the light bulb and the phonograph, which both worked perfectly the moment he built them.
options.zh: 他的每一项发明都一次成功，包括电灯泡和留声机，刚一做成就能完美运转。

explain.en: Edison said 'Negative results are just as valuable to me as positive results,' because he learned what did not work.
explain.zh: 爱迪生说“负面结果对我而言与正面结果同样有价值”，因为他能从中得知哪些方法行不通。

q.en: How did the nation honor Edison when he died in 1931?
q.zh: 1931年爱迪生逝世时，全国是如何纪念他的？

options.en: With a moment of silence only in New Jersey, where the governor declared a special holiday and all schools closed for a week to mourn Edison.
options.zh: 仅在新泽西州默哀片刻，该州州长宣布了一个特别假日，所有学校停课一周来悼念爱迪生。

options.en: By building a statue in every city
options.zh: 在每个城市立一座雕像

options.en: President Hoover asked everyone to briefly turn out the lights
options.zh: 胡佛总统请所有人短暂熄灯以致哀

explain.en: The book says President Herbert Hoover asked everyone in the country to turn out the lights for a short time to honor Edison.
explain.zh: 书中说赫伯特·胡佛总统请全国民众短暂熄灯，以纪念爱迪生。

prompt.en: Edison valued persistence and learning from failure. Describe a problem you have faced and explain how Edison's approach — trying many versions and refusing to give up — could help you solve it.
prompt.zh: 爱迪生重视坚持与从失败中学习。请描述你曾面临的一个难题，并说明爱迪生的方法——尝试多种方案、绝不放弃——能如何帮你解决它。

en: Remember the book says Edison's workers tried thousands of materials for the filament before one worked.
Think about his quote that negative results are as valuable as positive ones.
zh: 回想书中提到，爱迪生的团队为灯丝试了上千种材料才找到一种可行的。
想想他的那句话：负面结果与正面结果同样有价值。
